g.title: CerviGradeMasterV21
g.text: CerviGrade NCSP Master Decision Tree v2.1
Provisional recommendation - reviewer confirmation required - not for direct clinical action

g.title: STOP
g.text: Unknown is not false or normal

g.title: FOOT
g.text: Rulebook retains 203 records, including all 21 Table 1 cells and QA-01 through QA-18 corrections.
Clinician-only boxes are stopping points for software, not autonomous decisions.
Every result must store source rule ID, rule release, branch trace, input provenance, reviewer decision and immutable audit snapshot.

g.title: UNRES
g.text: Unresolved prior high-grade or glandular history?

g.title: TOCQ
g.text: Active or required high-grade squamous Test of Cure?

g.title: U25STOP
g.text: Symptoms/follow-up override; clinician review for early sexual activity/abuse

g.title: F1_NEXT
g.text: or previous high-grade with completed ToC

g.title: F1_F3
g.text: HPV primary screening at next visit

g.title: F2_HSIL
g.text: Previous HSIL or atypical glandular cells

g.title: F2_COLQ
g.text: Was colposcopy recommended and not completed?

g.title: F2_FU
g.text: Complete the appropriate ToC / specialist follow-up

g.title: F2_AISFU
g.text: Do not restart initial Figure 7 diagnosis

g.title: F2_ENDOQ
g.text: Report >3 years OR specialist assessed and discharged?

g.title: F2_PHPV
g.text: Primary HPV screening at next scheduled visit

g.title: F3_COMP
g.text: Age/DOB, HPV validity/result, sample type, event stage, immune status where relevant

g.title: F3_CSTOP
g.text: Missing critical Figure 3 facts -> request information

g.title: F3_U25STOP
g.text: If already in follow-up, use next indicated appointment

g.title: F3_INV
g.text: Repeat HPV as soon as practicable

g.title: F3_SWAB1618
g.text: If swab: obtain LBC/cytology at colposcopy

g.title: F3_RET_LBC
g.text: Return for clinical examination and clinician-taken LBC

g.title: F3_R1
g.text: First repeat HPV + cytology in 12 months

g.title: F3_R1OV
g.text: At every repeat: apply invalid/unsuitable, unsatisfactory-cytology,

g.title: F4_COMP
g.text: Normal-colposcopy date, TZ, immune status, repeat stage

g.title: F4_12
g.text: Repeat HPV in 12 months in community care

g.title: F4_TZ3
g.text: 2026: MDM cytology review not required before observation
Do not routinely excise; selected diagnostic excision/ECC remain clinician-led

g.title: F4_OV
g.text: At 12- and 24-month events apply Section 3 validity/adequacy

g.title: F4_NEG
g.text: 5 years if immune competent / 3 years if verified immune deficient

g.title: F4_24
g.text: Repeat HPV + cytology in another 12 months

g.title: F4_24NEG
g.text: 5 years if immune competent / 3 years if verified immune deficient

g.title: F5_COMP
g.text: TZ, lesion status, original/reviewed cytology, MDM outcome

g.title: F5_6M
g.text: Repeat HPV + cytology + colposcopy in 6 months

g.title: F5_PERSIST
g.text: HPV detected + negative cytology + normal colposcopy

g.title: F5_NEG
g.text: HPV not detected + negative cytology + no lesion

g.title: F6_COMP
g.text: Eligibility basis, treatment/history records, modality, dates, cervix status

g.title: F6_STOP
g.text: Do not exclude wider high-grade ToC eligibility

g.title: F6_PC
g.text: Clear margins; positive margins age <50 (2026); other eligible plans

g.title: F6_CC
g.text: Positive/incomplete margins age >=50 or specialist indication

g.title: F6_QBAD
g.text: Do not count as qualifying negative

g.title: F6_COL
g.text: Any HPV detected OR ASC-H/HSIL/glandular cytology

g.title: F7_MALIGN
g.text: URGENT colposcopist or gynaecology -> oncology when confirmed

g.title: F7_TZ
g.text: No visible lesion: TZ type known?

g.title: F7_TZSTOP
g.text: TZ type unknown -> specialist safety stop

g.title: F7_CONF
g.text: Type 3 excision + D&C/endometrial assessment as applicable

g.title: F7_HPVGET
g.text: Obtain HPV status before treatment where applicable

g.title: F7_LIFE
g.text: Annual co-testing for life unless qualifying hysterectomy

g.title: F7_ABN
g.text: Any HPV detected or abnormal cytology

g.title: CA_LRES
g.text: During ToC: HPV detected or cytology abnormal?

g.title: CA_NONC
g.text: Non-cervical gyn cancer + prior HSIL without ToC
Complete vault ToC; cease after two double-negative co-tests

g.title: H_COMP
g.text: Type, indication, prior history, specimen pathology, completeness

g.title: H_G2
g.text: G2: low-grade not returned to regular

g.title: H_G3
g.text: G3: treated HSIL with completed ToC

g.title: H_G5
g.text: G5: prior treatment with incomplete ToC

g.title: H_VDET
g.text: Reviewer-confirmed vault pathway / colposcopy as required

g.title: H_VCOL
g.text: Any HPV detected or abnormal vaginal cytology

g.title: F9_COMP
g.text: Gestational age, EDD/delivery date, exact cytology, TZ/lesion, invasion/MDM state

g.title: F9_CSTOP
g.text: Missing pregnancy-pathway facts -> mandatory specialist review

g.title: F9_MALIGN
g.text: URGENT experienced colposcopy + oncology/MDT as appropriate

g.title: F9_INV
g.text: Invasion suspected from cytology OR colposcopy?

g.title: F9_CONF
g.text: No definitive treatment during pregnancy unless invasion

g.title: F9_PP
g.text: Postpartum assessment no earlier than 6 weeks after documented delivery

g.title: F10_COMP
g.text: Bleeding type, history, examination, cervix appearance, cancer suspicion

g.title: F10_HYST
g.text: Remain in symptom pathway regardless of vault result

g.title: F10_SINGLE
g.text: Single premenopausal PCB + normal cervix + double-negative co-test?

g.title: F10_URG
g.text: Do not delay for blood or co-test result

g.title: F10_NOCOL
g.text: No colposcopy solely for this episode

g.title: F10_REF
g.text: Specialist gynaecology regardless of reassuring tests

g.title: CIN2_CHOICE
g.text: Participant requests treatment while CIN2 remains?

g.title: CIN2_REG
g.text: Discharge; Test of Cure at 12 months

g.title: IMM_PROV
g.text: Record classifier, evidence, date, rationale, specialist input
and whether immune status was sent on laboratory request

g.title: IMM_NO
g.text: Not immune deficient on this fact alone
Use ordinary interval unless another indication

g.title: DES_REG
g.text: Applicable regular interval after specialist confirmation
